assumptions.note: ESTIMATE ONLY. Every parameter below is an assumption chosen by us (not a BEACON, DSN or KDSA specification); change them with --budget-json. Range uses the worst (largest) and mean Moon-Earth distance in the ephemeris window.

concept: BEACON (NASA GRC, NTRS 20240014584): 15 m deployed boom, users up to ~10 km

coverage.order: row-major; rows south to north; cell centres are origin+(index+0.5)*spacing
coverage.meaning: Local geometric reach of each best single tower, NOT end-to-end availability. No receiver sunlight, interference, antenna gain or station scheduling constraint.
